license_required.quote: A person may not practice podiatric medicine unless that person first has obtained a license or permit to do so.

issuing_authority.value: North Dakota Board of Podiatric Medicine
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the North Dakota board of podiatric medicine.

name.value: North Dakota Board of Podiatric Medicine
name.quote: The board of podiatric medicine consists of six persons appointed by the governor

type.quote: The board of podiatric medicine consists of six persons appointed by the governor for a term of four years each

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (D.P.M.) from an accredited podiatric medical school
degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of a podiatric medical school approved by the board based upon its faculty, curriculum, facilities, accreditation by a recognized national accrediting organization approved by the board, and other relevant factors.

accrediting_body.value: Council on Podiatric Medical Education, American Podiatric Medical Association, or other accrediting agency approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: accreditation by a recognized national accrediting organization approved by the board

required.quote: Applicants graduating after July 1, 1991, from a podiatric medical school shall present to the board evidence of the successful completion of a program of clinical residency.

duration.value: Clinical residency or preceptorship as approved by the board
duration.quote: "Clinical residency" means a formal, structured postdoctoral training program approved by the board, which is sponsored by and conducted in an accredited institution approved by the board or conducted by a college of podiatric medicine accredited and approved by the council on podiatric medical education, American podiatric medical association, or other accrediting agency approved by the board.

kind.quote: "Preceptorship" means a formal, structured postdoctoral training program approved by the board and conducted by a podiatrist primarily in an office setting and controlled and supervised by a college of podiatric medicine accredited by the council on podiatric medical education, American podiatric medical association, or another accrediting agency approved by the board.

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME) Licensing Examination
exams.quote: The board may issue a license or permit to an applicant who has received a passing score on each section of the national board of podiatric medical examiners licensing examination or such other licensing examination as determined by the board.

exams.name: Oral Practical Examination
exams.quote: An applicant shall appear in person before the board or its designated representative to complete an oral practical examination and show that the applicant satisfies the requirements for licensure. The board may accept a national clinical examination prepared and graded by the national board of podiatric medical examiners in lieu of the oral practical examination.

interval_years.quote: A license to practice podiatric medicine is effective for one year subject to the terms and conditions for renewal established by the board.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The license fee may be increased in accordance with the number of years licensed and practicing in North Dakota, but may not exceed seven hundred fifty dollars.

required.quote: Upon renewal of any license, the board may require the applicant to show sufficient proof of continuing medical education since the last application, which may include seminars or podiatry meetings.

requirements.value: Applicant must have been engaged in active practice for at least 2 years immediately preceding application, have current license in another state/province, not have had license suspended/revoked, and not have engaged in conduct warranting disciplinary action.
requirements.quote: The applicant has been engaged legally in the active practice of podiatric medicine for at least two years immediately preceding the date of application; ... The applicant presents satisfactory evidence to the board indicating the current status of a license to practice podiatric medicine which has been issued by the proper agency in another state or Canadian province; ... The applicant has not had a license suspended or revoked, or has not engaged in conduct warranting or which would have warranted disciplinary action against a licensee if the conduct was committed in this state or elsewhere

exists.quote: The board of podiatric medicine consists of six persons appointed by the governor for a term of four years each

national_certification.value: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME)
national_certification.quote: The board may issue a license or permit to an applicant who has received a passing score on each section of the national board of podiatric medical examiners licensing examination

national_association.quote: a college of podiatric medicine accredited and approved by the council on podiatric medical education, American podiatric medical association, or other accrediting agency approved by the board

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not practice podiatric medicine unless that person first has obtained a license or permit to do so.

credential_type.quote: A person may not practice podiatric medicine unless that person first has obtained a license or permit to do so.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice podiatric medicine unless that person first has obtained a license or permit to do so.

title_protection.quote: A person may not do any of the following unless that person holds a valid license or permit: ... Use the designation "doctor of podiatric medicine", "podiatrist", "D.P.M.", "podiatric physician", "chiropodist", "foot specialist", or "foot doctor", or use any title, degree, letters, symbol, or words that would tend to lead the public to believe that that person is authorized to practice or assume duties incident to the practice of podiatric medicine.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice podiatric medicine unless that person first has obtained a license or permit to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to demonstrate the qualification or satisfy the requirements for a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to demonstrate the qualification or satisfy the requirements for a license or permit under this chapter or rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license or permit by fraud or cheating or attempting to subvert the licensing or permit examination process
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a license or permit by fraud or cheating or attempting to subvert the licensing or permit examination process, the use of any false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document, or the use of any fraudulent, deceitful, dishonest, or immoral practice in connection with any of the license or permit requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor or felony reasonably related to the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction, during the previous five years, of a misdemeanor or felony reasonably related to the practice of podiatric medicine, or determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a person's ability to serve the public as a podiatrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, limitation, or other disciplinary action against the person's podiatric medical license in another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension, restriction, limitation, or other disciplinary action against the person's podiatric medical license in another state or jurisdiction, failure to report to the board that charges regarding the person's license have been brought in another state or jurisdiction, or failure to report to the board that the person has been refused a license by another state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is false or misleading, or making false or misleading statements about skill, training, experience, or ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is false or misleading, or the making of any false or misleading statement about the podiatrist's skill, training, experience, or ability or the efficacy of any treatment or remedy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a rule adopted by the board, an order of the board, any provision of this chapter, or state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule adopted by the board; an order of the board; any provision of this chapter; any action, stipulation, condition, or agreement imposed by the board; a state or federal law that relates to the practice of podiatric medicine; or a state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any unethical conduct or conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any unethical conduct; conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public; demonstrating a willful, careless, or negligent disregard for the health, welfare, or safety of a patient; or podiatric medical practice that is professionally incompetent, in that it may create unnecessary danger to any patient's life, health, or safety regardless of whether an actual injury is proved.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise a preceptor or resident
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise a preceptor or resident.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person in the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed, incompetent, or impaired person in the practice of podiatric medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication by a court as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, or a person dangerous to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication by a court of competent jurisdiction as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent, a person dangerous to the public, or a person who has a psychopathic personality.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct that includes any departure from or the failure to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing podiatric medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unprofessional conduct that includes any departure from or the failure to conform to the minimal standards of acceptable and prevailing podiatric medical practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of physical or mental illness, substance use disorder, or mental or physical condition or disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of physical or mental illness, a substance use disorder, or as a result of any mental or physical condition or disability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when otherwise required or permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revealing a privileged communication from or relating to a patient except when otherwise required or permitted by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper management of medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improper management of medical records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, paying, or promising to pay a part of a fee in exchange for patient referrals or obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, paying, or promising to pay a part of a fee in exchange for patient referrals; obtaining any fee by fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation; or paying or receiving, directly or indirectly, any fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for services not actually or personally rendered, except for the lawful distribution of compensation or fees within a professional partnership, corporation, or association.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in abusive or fraudulent billing practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of, or becoming addicted or habituated to, alcohol or drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of, or becoming addicted or habituated to, alcohol or drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, administering, or distributing a drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, administering, or distributing a drug for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes, experimental, or investigative purposes authorized by a state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual misconduct, sexual abuse, or exploitation with or of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual misconduct, sexual abuse, or exploitation with or of a patient; conduct that may reasonably be interpreted by the patient as sexual; or in verbal behavior which is seductive or sexually demeaning to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The failure to furnish the board or representatives information legally requested by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to furnish the board or representatives information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A continued pattern of inappropriate care as a podiatrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A continued pattern of inappropriate care as a podiatrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The practice of podiatric medicine under a false or assumed name other than a partnership name containing the names of one or more of the licensed partners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of podiatric medicine under a false or assumed name other than a partnership name containing the names of one or more of the licensed partners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining a professional office in conjunction or relation with any business not engaged in the practice of the medical sciences
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Maintaining a professional office in conjunction or relation with any business not engaged in the practice of the medical sciences.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Treating any disease, sickness, illness, malady, or defect that is outside the scope of the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Treating any disease, sickness, illness, malady, or defect that is outside the scope of the practice of podiatric medicine.

definition_quote.value: The medical and surgical treatment and diagnosis of ailments of the human foot, ankle, and other related soft tissue structures below the tibial tuberosity that govern the functions of the foot and ankle, not including extra articular osseous injuries above the distal metaphyseal scar. Podiatrists may treat and diagnose conditions of the foot and ankle by any medically accepted system or method necessary
definition_quote.quote: The medical and surgical treatment and diagnosis of ailments of the human foot, ankle, and other related soft tissue structures below the tibial tuberosity that govern the functions of the foot and ankle, not including extra articular osseous injuries above the distal metaphyseal scar. Podiatrists may treat and diagnose conditions of the foot and ankle by any medically accepted system or method necessary

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may use such preparations, medicines, and drugs as may be necessary for the treatment of ailments of the foot and ankle
drug_authority.quote: The use of such preparations, medicines, and drugs as may be necessary for the treatment of such ailments

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: The medical and surgical treatment and diagnosis of ailments of the human foot, ankle, and other related soft tissue structures below the tibial tuberosity that govern the functions of the foot and ankle, not including extra articular osseous injuries above the distal metaphyseal scar.

amputation_authorized.quote: The amputation of the toes, parts of the foot, or foot in its entirety, indicated as medically necessary

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: The sale of shoes or preformed arch supports in the stores of this state.

preoperative_history_and_physical_author.quote: The performance of history and physical examinations upon admitting patients to facilities where they are recognized with requisite credentials and privileges

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: That podiatrists may function as assistant surgeons in nonpodiatric procedures
